items.title: Danone joins Nestlé and Coca-Cola in labelling changes
items.summary: Danone joins Nestlé and Coca-Cola in revising plastic bottle recycling claims following a European Commission crackdown on potential greenwashing

items.title: Nestlé turnaround taking shape a year after new CEO
items.summary: Philipp Navratil said innovations and category divestitures have helped lead to improvements in key markets like North America, but he’s still “not satisfied” with the company’s performance.

items.title: P&G warns of a sharp rise in costs, but consumers keep buying
items.summary: Procter & Gamble is seeing its raw material and transportation costs rise more sharply than expected due to high oil prices. Nevertheless, the American manufacturer of Pampers, Ariel, and Gillette is performing better than predicted. Beauty products and household goods, in…

items.title: Heineken warns: weight-loss products threaten beer sales
items.summary: The rise of weight-loss drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy is having a growing impact on the beer industry. Heineken is warning British bar and restaurant owners that consumers are drinking less alcohol and urging them to adjust their offerings. Research confirms that these drugs…

items.title: Heineken Document Reveals Worries Over Weight-Loss Drugs And Beer Sales
items.summary: Heineken urges British pubs to adapt to growing weight-loss drug use or risk losing customers and revenue as beer sales come under threat.

items.title: How AB InBev built a culture of creative effectiveness that drives growth
items.summary: To focus its marketing efforts, the Bud Light owner looks for opportunities at the intersection of consumer needs and business problems, rather than chasing creative ideas intended to generate hype or buzz.

items.title: L'Oréal Shares Bounce On Third-Quarter Sales
items.summary: Shares in L'Oréal rose 5% on Friday, hitting their highest in more than two years, after the it reported Q3 sales well ahead of expectations.

items.title: UPF labeling could cost $14.2bn annually, study estimates
items.summary: A new study estimates mandatory UPF labeling could cost $14.2bn annually and affect 72% of packaged foods, as industry warns of added costs and legal risks.

items.title: Elopak ASA – Håkon Volldal To Assume CEO Role From 2 November 2026
items.summary: Elopak’s board of directors is pleased to confirm that Håkon Volldal will assume the CEO role from 2 November 2026.

items.title: Nestlé factory closure signals new era of industry consolidation
items.summary: Nestlé's Solon factory closure highlights the food giant's drive to streamline manufacturing operations, reflecting a wider industry trend towards consolidating production, improving efficiency and adapting facilities to changing consumer demand.

items.title: EU Parliament And Council Agree To Simplify Rules For Organic Products
items.summary: EU Parliament and Council reach a provisional deal to simplify organic rules, reduce red tape and boost the sector’s competitiveness.

items.title: Aldi and Lidl will no longer be able to block competitors in the UK
items.summary: In the United Kingdom, Aldi and Lidl are now subject to the same licensing rules as traditional supermarket chains. This gives their major competitors what they wanted: they had long been demanding a level playing field.

items.title: L’Oréal outpaces the beauty market thanks to luxury and skincare
items.summary: L’Oréal had an exceptionally strong third quarter. The French cosmetics giant saw its revenue rise by nearly 12%, thanks to strong demand for premium hair care, dermatological cosmetics, and luxury products.

items.title: Maisons du Monde’s revenue plummets 21% due to inventory problems
items.summary: Maisons du Monde is experiencing a particularly difficult third quarter. Online sales, in particular, are taking a heavy hit, but ongoing inventory issues and fewer promotions are also taking a heavy toll on the French home furnishings chain.

items.title: ESM’s Retail Wrap – Carrefour, Patrizia, Lidl Switzerland, ESD Italia
items.summary: Carrefour and ADP team up for airport stores; Patrizia invests in Lidl real estate; Lidl Switzerland and WWF promote sustainable consumption.

items.title: Broeklin Brussels also signs Marie Méro, Orange, and Japanese “fast casual” dining
items.summary: Broeklin Brussels has announced four more new tenants. With these new additions, the shopping center now has a total of twelve announced brands. The Belgian fashion brand Marie Méro and telecom operator Orange will open stores there, and the Japanese-inspired dining concepts…

items.title: How functional became food’s future
Walmart Launches Tools For AI Agents To Shop For Customers
items.summary: Walmart has introduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers.

items.title: Reese’s Christmas rollout signals new confectionery playbook
items.summary: Hershey expands Reese’s for Christmas with Advent calendars, selection boxes and festive favourites. The launch highlights key confectionery trends including seasonal innovation, larger sharing formats and the growing power of trusted brands.

items.title: Leftovers: Lays gives thanks with holiday flavors | Dogfish Head brews ‘ancient’ beer
items.summary: The potato chip brand is releasing a seasonal lineup based on Thanksgiving favorites, while Tajín introduces a swicy chamoy sauce.

items.title: Koen Tengrootenhuysen leaves Decathlon after twenty years
items.summary: After twenty years, Koen Tengrootenhuysen is leaving sports retailer Decathlon. He played a key role in the chain’s store expansion and real estate strategy in the Benelux. He will announce his next career move at a later date.

items.title: General Mills, Archer and Conagra beef up their meat snack portfolios
items.summary: Explore new meat sticks from General Mills, Archer and Conagra, including Epic Wagyu beef, oven-roasted chicken and Slim Jim Cheese Mode.

items.title: Protein chips attract funding amid competitive protein-snackscape
items.summary: Wilde, known for turning chicken into protein chips, landed a $40 million investment from S2G Investments as competition intensifies in the booming protein-snacking category.

items.title: SPAR International To Launch AI-Based Retail Media Marketplace
High protein won’t last forever
items.summary: The high protein trend is all encompassing, spreading to nearly every corner of the food industry. But trends come and go. Food companies must be prepared for a time when such a trend is no longer so widespread.

items.title: Reusable e-commerce packaging passes consumer test
items.summary: Consumers appear willing to return shipping packaging, especially when they can easily get their deposit back. That’s the finding of a pilot project by Bpost, Torfs, and Juttu. The challenge is now shifting from consumer behavior to logistics and profitability: who will organize…

items.title: Modern slavery: 97% of food and drink firms identify risks in supply chains
[In the picture] Aldi opens a pop-up wine bar in Antwerp
items.summary: To prove, in the run-up to the holidays, that good wine doesn't have to be expensive, Aldi is opening its own pop-up wine bar, Al Divino, in the heart of Antwerp. Visitors can stop by until November 1.

items.title: South African Household Hunger Reaches Highest Level Since 2010 – Shoprite
items.summary: Household hunger reached its highest level in 15 years in South Africa in 2025, notes the South African Food Security Index 2026.
